data.narrative:
Nordic Air Defence is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Karl Rosander. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies spanning both Seed and Series A, with a broader comp universe including 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method provides the primary valuation anchor. The three comparable companies—UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A)—yield a median valuation of $400M, with the range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This peer-median approach reflects comparable market positioning and financing stage within the Defense & Security sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation band of $340M to $460M, centered on $400M. This range reflects the median peer valuation with downside protection at $340M and upside to $460M. Key uncertainties include the limited peer set of three comparables, stage variance within the cohort (one Seed versus two Series A), and the absence of disclosed fundraising data for Nordic Air Defence itself, which constrains calibration to the company's specific capital needs and burn profile. Further diligence on revenue traction, customer pipeline, and funding requirements would refine placement within this band.
